file_level_heuristics.description: All worksheets are represented in this single JSON file.

extraction_notes: Every non-empty cell is preserved with its original worksheet coordinate and value.
Tables and key-value pairs are heuristic interpretations; raw cell inventory is retained as the source of truth.
Formula expressions and cached results are both included when present; cached values can be null.
Blank cells are omitted as individual records; original coordinates and sheet dimensions are retained.
Heuristic triggers are indicators for downstream review, not underwriting decisions.
